notes: Document stances and layers agreed (SBMI permit, McGovern restrict). Main disagreements: (1) modality for tool-availability statements (informs vs may); resolved as may where the sentence makes a licensed or hosted tool available to students, informs for facts about data safety. (2) unit_stance for citation units (permit vs require) and sanction (restrict vs prohibit); resolved as permit/restrict because citation is a condition on allowed AI use and the sanction attaches to missing citation. (3) phase (general vs during-work, before-course vs during-work); resolved by whether the sentence is tied to doing coursework. (4) policy_type: P77 vs P45 for 'policies on plagiarism still apply' resolved to P77; all other types agreed. (5) Coverage: A-only units kept (summarize-text use, ChatGPT-for-editing exception, course-materials commitment); B-only units kept (AIChat data does not leave premises, opportunities to explore AI in assignments); A's duplicate FERPA/HIPAA unit dropped as an exact repeat. The A-only course-materials unit and B-only opportunities unit are adjacent but state different rules, so both counted as unmatched.
